reviewMethod: All 12 final-package arrival screenshots were visually screened together at thumbnail scale in the contact sheet; Farley Hall and 1405 Jackson Avenue were additionally checked at full resolution because their entries were unclear. This is a visibility review of the captured view, not verification that inferred non-campus door coordinates are field-accurate.
